status: provisional; frozen by the agent 2026-11-22, margins pending owner approval at the rental checkpoint
target: Qwen3.5-4B Q4KM (primary); the same frozen gate runs on NVFP4 as a measured secondary result
role: Evaluation-only public gate. Never used for training, calibration, selection or tuning; run once on frozen finalists. TRAIN is decontaminated against every source below.
runtime: Pinned fork runtime of the release, depth calibrated per arm on DEV and also reported at depth 3, context 32768, batch 1, one server slot, prompt cache off, exact decode consistency on, prefix caching off
arms: 4-bit control trained to its plateau on the same TRAIN manifest

metrics.speed: generated tokens divided by summed full HTTP request seconds, per arm
metrics.comparison: paired source-group bootstrap (statistics.paired, 2000 draws, category strata), candidate over comparator
metrics.acceptance: accepted draft tokens / proposed draft tokens
metrics.tau: accepted draft tokens per verification round; emitted tokens per round (tau + 1) also published
metrics.correctness: greedy outputs exact against target-only; sampled outputs valid under the native verifier qualification

pass_rule_provisional.versus_stock_baseline: general lower bound > 1.00; every guardrail scenario lower bound >= 0.97 with at most two guardrails below 1.00; all outputs correct
pass_rule_provisional.versus_trained_control: general lower bound >= 0.97; every guardrail lower bound >= 0.95; all outputs correct; claim wording 'within 3% of a Baseline fine-tuned on the same data, or faster'
pass_rule_provisional.unavailable: a missing scenario, an unavailable interval, or an invalid output cannot pass

sensitivity_controls: stock Baseline against itself in reversed arm order on the general scenario, to measure session drift before the gate
detectable effect estimated from historical paired source-group differences before freezing counts

control_plateau_rule.checkpoints: 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, ... updates (doublings), constant step size after warm-up
control_plateau_rule.outcome: acceptance on the rebuilt DEV screen, overall and on the agentic, sampled and tool-call strata
control_plateau_rule.stop: after at least 16K updates, two successive doublings whose paired 95% upper bound on further gain is below +0.5 points overall and below +1.0 on each listed stratum
control_plateau_rule.extend: any listed stratum still improving, or intervals too wide to meet the rule
control_plateau_rule.finish: a short cosine anneal (10% of the reached updates) on the next unseen part of the manifest, then served timing at calibrated depth
control_plateau_rule.disclosure: publish the whole curve, the reached updates and the manifest fraction consumed

decontamination: TRAIN excludes every source identity above, and every TRAIN prompt sharing a 13-token shingle run (at least 12 shared shingles and 35% containment) with any gate prompt, plus repository families of the agentic replay sources
exposure: MBPP and LongBench/GovReport ancestry overlaps the spent confirmation reserve and is not used here; heldout24 stays untouched
